reviews.comment: Great professor for CVEN 446. Every person I talked to in my class also loved him. Super nice guy, very funny and chill. Graded on three exams and a group project. His tests aren't "easy" but he doesn't throw you curveballs, rather exams essentially test if you pay attention to him and work hard. His grading is also very nice for engineering. 10/10

Prof. Yarnold is one of, if not the best, CVEN professor at A&M. I have taken him twice, for CVEN345 and for CVEN444. Homeworks are usually participation graded and records lectures that need to be watched before class. If you watch the lectures and do the homeworks as well as learn the Steel Manual very well you will do fine on the tests.

Great professor. His class is tough but his tests are very straight forward & he doesn't throw curve balls. His homeworks are completion grades but they help a lot. He's very thorough & explains the material very well.
